name: Kipu Quantum
description: Kipu Quantum develops compressed quantum algorithms designed to reduce the resource requirements of quantum computations, aiming to accelerate the timeline to industrially useful quantum computers. Founded in Karlsruhe with offices in Berlin, the company works with hardware partners to co-design application- and hardware-specific quantum solutions for near-term quantum advantage.

products.name: Compressed Quantum Algorithms
products.description: Hardware-specific compressed quantum circuits that reduce resource requirements for near-term quantum advantage

highlights: Develops compressed quantum computing techniques to accelerate practical quantum advantage
Co-designs application- and hardware-specific solutions with leading quantum hardware partners
Raised EUR 13.5M+ to scale algorithm development across multiple industry verticals

sources.title: 10.5 Million EUR for German Quantum Software Company Kipu Quantum

news.title: Kipu Quantum launches Rimay quantum feature extraction service
news.excerpt: Rimay integrates quantum-extracted features into classical ML pipelines, with reported accuracy gains for credit-risk, predictive maintenance and leak-detection use cases.
